intro: Watersedge at River Place is the Lake Austin side section of River Place, with homes between about $1M and $3M. CleanzATX cleans windows here with pure water, and Tyler quotes each home himself by text.

paragraphs: Watersedge sits on the lake side of River Place, where the hills drop toward Lake Austin. It is a small section, so you will not find rows of identical houses. Values run from about $1M to $3M, which tells you the range: some homes are comfortable family houses and others are larger custom builds with long back elevations. Lots slope toward the water, and the back of the house is usually the tall side, two or three stories of glass and stone above the grade. Live oaks, cedar and native brush crowd in, and River Place HOA keeps the common areas trimmed.

River Place is a community of its own on the north shore, with the country club and canyon trail close by. Watersedge is not gated, which makes it easy for us to get a truck to the door and work from the drive.

Being near the lake changes the glass. Spray and humid air leave a fine mineral film, and sprinklers add to it. Left alone, that white spotting can etch into glass until it no longer wipes off. Pure water prevents the problem from growing: our dual RO, 4 stage system with a DI resin tank gives water near 0 TDS, so panes dry with nothing left on them. Back windows that face west toward the water catch hard afternoon sun, and a streak or soap film is the first thing you see. Water fed poles reach up to three stories from the ground, which suits the tall lake side wall.

Spider webs build fast in the corners of a shaded, damp yard, and leaf litter packs into tracks. Screens are $5, full screens $10, solar screens $15, and tracks are $5. Etched or heavily spotted panes get hard water removal at $10 per pane.

The homes are not behind a gate, so scheduling is easy: we text when we are on the way, set up at the front or side and work around the house. Exterior glass goes first from the ground, then screens and tracks, then interior by hand if you chose inside and out. Pool decks and patios, where homes have them, are cleaned by hand so they do not get soaked, and limestone is only soft washed, never pressure washed. Most work is booked within about two weeks, and we group Watersedge with nearby River Place stops.

For a home of about 4,000 sq ft, exterior windows at $0.10 per sq ft are about $400. Allow roughly three to four hours outside and about two hours inside. Cleaning the inside too brings it to $15 per window for both sides.

faq.a: They can. Mineral spotting that sits for months can etch the glass so it will not wipe clean. Cleaning with pure water early keeps new spots from setting, and hard water removal is $10 per pane.

faq.q: Do you clean the tall lake side wall without ladders?
faq.a: Yes. Water fed poles reach up to three stories from the ground, so we do the exterior glass without putting ladders against the house. Interior glass is done by hand.

faq.q: Is Watersedge on your River Place route?
faq.a: It is. We pair Watersedge with other River Place stops, and most jobs are booked within about two weeks. Text (512) 518-0512 and we will quote by text, usually within the hour during business hours.

faq.q: What do I do about my stone and stucco?
faq.a: Soft wash for a house begins at $0.20 per sq ft, $400 minimum. We use a 12V soft wash system for limestone and stucco. Pressure washing limestone is never done, because it damages the face.
